generations.prompt: Photoreal, noon in a city park, 35 mm, locked-off camera that does not move. The two old men in flat caps on the bench behind are the only people talking: they turn toward each other in a slow, natural, continuous conversation, their lips moving, one gesturing with a hand. The woman with the pram walks along the path behind them and out of frame without speaking. The silver-haired woman in the mustard-yellow raincoat on the near bench is completely silent: her lips stay closed and still for the whole shot, she never speaks, mouths words, laughs or hums; she closes her eyes for a moment in the sun, glances toward the two old men with a faint closed-mouth smile, then looks down and draws in her sketchbook, her pencil moving. Dappled light moves on the gravel as the leaves stir. No new person enters; nothing new appears. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
